Method of Attack: Steals data from mobile instant messaging clients by extracting and exfiltrating IM data
Gains boot persistence by modifying /system/etc/install-recovery.sh to execute malware on every boot
Uses anti-emulator and debugger detection techniques to evade dynamic analysis
Hides strings inside source code to thwart code reversing attempts
Impacted Systems: Android mobile instant messaging clients including Facebook Messenger, Skype, Telegram, Twitter, WeChat, Weibo, Viber, Line, Coco, BeeTalk, Momo, Voxer Walkie Talkie Messenger, Gruveo Magic Call, TalkBox Voice Messenger
Indicators of Compromise: IP of remote server retrieved from local configuration file
Attack Vector: Distributed via third-party app stores and links on Android app forums, especially in China
